# Stream Deck script functions

Functions for C# (`Cb.Call`) and Python (`cb.call`). See [Script functions](index.md) for how to use them.

## streamdeck.getInstances

Lists the Stream Deck apps that are connected to Cuebot, with their devices and Cuebot keys.

**Gives back:** A list of apps. Each has id, remote, pluginVersion, streamDeckVersion, platform, connectedAt, devices (name, type, size) and buttons (buttonId, row, column, state and more).

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("streamdeck.getInstances");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.call("streamdeck.getInstances")
    ```

## streamdeck.isConnected

Checks whether the Cuebot plugin in the Stream Deck app is connected right now.

**Gives back:** true while at least one Stream Deck plugin is connected, otherwise false.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("streamdeck.isConnected");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.call("streamdeck.isConnected")
    ```

## streamdeck.setBackground

Changes the picture on a Stream Deck key. Leave the image empty to put the normal picture back.

| Value | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| `buttonId` | The button id you gave the key in the Cuebot Stream Deck plugin. Needed. |
| `image` | A picture file on your computer, a web link (http or https) or a data: link. Empty puts the normal picture back. |
| `state` | Optional. Which state of a two-state key to change: 0 or 1. Leave it out for the state it shows now. |

**Gives back:** How many keys have this button id (0 when none was found).

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("streamdeck.setBackground", new { buttonId = "scene", image = "C:\\Stream\\live.png" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.call("streamdeck.setBackground", buttonId="scene", image="C:\\Stream\\live.png")
    ```

## streamdeck.setState

Switches a two-state Stream Deck key to state 0 or 1.

| Value | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| `buttonId` | The button id you gave the key in the Cuebot Stream Deck plugin. Needed. |
| `state` | Optional. 0 or 1. Default 0. |

**Gives back:** How many keys have this button id (0 when none was found).

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("streamdeck.setState", new { buttonId = "mic", state = 1 });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.call("streamdeck.setState", buttonId="mic", state=1)
    ```

## streamdeck.setTitle

Changes the text shown on a Stream Deck key.

| Value | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| `buttonId` | The button id you gave the key in the Cuebot Stream Deck plugin, like "deaths". Needed. |
| `title` | The text to show, like "Deaths: 3". |
| `state` | Optional. Which state of a two-state key to change: 0 or 1. Leave it out for the state it shows now. |

**Gives back:** How many keys have this button id (0 when none was found).

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("streamdeck.setTitle", new { buttonId = "deaths", title = "Deaths: 3" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.call("streamdeck.setTitle", buttonId="deaths", title="Deaths: 3")
    ```

## streamdeck.setValue

Changes the value shown on a Stream Deck key or dial (Stream Deck +).

| Value | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| `buttonId` | The button id you gave the key or dial in the Cuebot Stream Deck plugin. Needed. |
| `value` | The value to show, like "75%". |
| `indicator` | Optional. For dials: how full the bar is, 0-100. |

**Gives back:** How many keys have this button id (0 when none was found).

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("streamdeck.setValue", new { buttonId = "volume", value = "75%", indicator = 75 });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.call("streamdeck.setValue", buttonId="volume", value="75%", indicator=75)
    ```

## streamdeck.toggleState

Flips a two-state Stream Deck key to its other state.

| Value | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| `buttonId` | The button id you gave the key in the Cuebot Stream Deck plugin. Needed. |

**Gives back:** How many keys have this button id (0 when none was found).

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("streamdeck.toggleState", new { buttonId = "mic" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python

    ```
